briefing:
### 1. التكتيك المعتمد وموقف الترتيب (Tactical Posture & Rank Dynamics)

يقبع الفريق حالياً في الترتيب العام المتأخر (10,601,382)، وهو ما يفرض علينا تبني استراتيجية هجومية تعويضية صارمة (**Aggressive Recovery Mode**). في هذه المرحلة المتأخرة رقمياً، يصبح اللعب التحفظي أو مسايرة اختيارات الأغلبية (Template) انتحاراً تكتيكياً يقيد القدرة على الصعود. الشعار هنا هو: *"النقاط هي النقاط أياً كان مصدرها"*. 

يقوم تكتيك الجولة 6 على تفكيك الأصول المتراجعة بلا تردد، وتوظيف سيولة البنك البالغة **£5.0m** لفتح آفاق مرونة مستقبلية واسعة، مع تكثيف القوة الضاربة في خط الوسط (3-5-2) لمهاجمة الفارق النقطي وتقليص الفجوة الترتيبية سريعاً عبر فوارق نقطية حاسمة (Differentials).

---

### 2. مطابقة القرارات للقواعد الذهبية (Gold Rules Compliance)

جاءت القرارات الفنية لهذه الجولة منسجمة بصورة تامة مع محرك القواعد التاريخية المثبتة:

* **جدوى كسر النقاط (Hit Validation):** تنص القاعدة الذهبية (بنسبة ثقة 80%) على أن أخذ خصومات نقطية مجدولة تاريخياً (حتى 20 ضربة سالبة بمحصلة -80 نقطة عبر الموسم) يعد الأمثل رياضياً لاقتناص الانفجارات التهديفية. الخصم الحالي (-4) ليس مخاطرة عشوائية، بل هو استثمار فوري محسوب لإعادة هيكلة خط الوسط بمعدل عائد متوقع يفوق كلفة الخصم سريعاً.
* **كفاءة الميزانية (Price Efficiency):** أثبتت القاعدة (بنسبة ثقة 80%) أن الفئة السعرية الاقتصادية الأقل من **£6.0m** هي الأعلى إنتاجية تاريخياً بمعدل (2.69 نقطة لكل مليون جنيه). استقطاب باسكال غروس (**Groß**) بسعر **£5.8m** يجسد التطبيق الحرفي لهذه القاعدة، حيث يجمع بين السعر الاقتصادي ومعدل النقاط المتوقعة المرتفع.
* **ثقل خط الوسط (Position Allocation):** توجيه التشكيلة للاعتماد على 5 أسطر في الوسط يحاكي التوزيع المثالي للإنفاق الذي يمنح خط الوسط ما يقارب **39.8%** من ميزانية التشكيل الأساسي؛ نظراً لأن لاعبي الوسط يحصدون نقاطاً أعلى للشباك النظيفة والأهداف، وهو ما يضمن الاستغلال الأقصى للمعادلة الرياضية.

---

### 3. التحليل الرياضي للتبديلات وجدوى الخصم (-4 Hit) على مدى 3 جولات

القرارات المنفذة قائمة على النماذج التنبؤية (xP) والجدول التنافسي (FDR) دون أي ارتباط عاطفي بالأسماء:

| التبديل | اللاعب المغادر (OUT) | xP | اللاعب القادم (IN) | السعر | xP | الجولات القادمة (GW 6-8) |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **1** | Tavernier (BOU) | 5.0 | **Groß (BHA)** | £5.8m | **7.0** | SUN (A) [3] \| CRY (H) [2] \| LIV (A) [4] |
| **2** | Palmer (CHE) | 3.8 | **Scott (BOU)** | £6.1m | **5.4** | CHE (A) [4] \| SUN (H) [3] \| MUN (A) [4] |

* **تحليل الخروج:** تم التخلص من **Palmer** بلا تردد؛ إذ يعكس مؤشره التوقعي المتدني (**3.8 xP**) تراجعاً حاداً في الإنتاجية الهجومية مقابل سعره المرتفع، بينما وصل **Tavernier** إلى سقف مردوده (**5.0 xP**) مع توافر بديل أكثر حسماً في الكرات الثابتة والمساهمات التهديفية.
* **تحليل الدخول:** يمثل **Groß** صفقة النخبة لهذه الجولة بمعدل **7.0 xP** وجدول مثالي يتضمن مواجهة كريستال بالاس على الأرض (FDR: 2)، بينما يوفر **Scott** فاعلية هجومية بسعر متوازن وفارق تنافسي (Differential) بملكية متدنية للغاية.
* **معادلة الـ Hit على مدى 3 جولات:**
  * النقاط المتوقعة الفورية للبدلاء: $(7.0 + 5.4) = 12.4$ نقطة.
  * النقاط المتوقعة للراحلين: $(5.0 + 3.8) = 8.8$ نقطة.
  * الفارق الفوري المباشر: $+3.6$ نقطة، وهو ما يغطي تقريباً كامل تكلفة الخصم (-4) من الجولة الأولى وحدها. وبامتداد الأفق الرياضي لثلاث جولات، وبفضل جدول برايتون المؤاتي واحتكار غروس للكرات الثابتة، فإن صافي العائد المتوقع يتجاوز **+7.5 نقطة صافية** فوق تكلفة الـ Hit، محققاً شرط الجدوى الرياضية الصارمة.

---

### 4. حسم شارة القيادة (C) والنائب (VC)

* **الكابتن (C): برونو فيرنانديز (B.Fernandes - MUN) | xP: 8.4**  
  الاختيار الأساسي المستحق رياضياً؛ فاللاعب يمتلك أعلى معدل نقاط متوقعة في التشكيل بالكامل (**8.4 xP**)، وتمركزاً شاملاً في صناعة اللعب وتنفيذ ركلات الجزاء والكرات الثابتة. يمنحنا برونو سقفاً نقطياً مرتفعاً (High Explosive Ceiling) يتطابق مع متطلبات استراتيجيتنا الهجومية الصارمة لتعويض النقاط وكسر متوسط الجولة.

* **نائب الكابتن (VC): بوكايو ساكا (Saka - ARS) | xP: 6.9**  
  يمثل ساكا صمام الأمان المثالي والتأمين الإحصائي الأول بمعدل أمان ثابت (**Floor**) ومعدل مشاركة هجومية مرتفع مع أرسنال، ليكون الجدار الحامي في حال حدوث أي غياب مفاجئ لبرونو فيرنانديز قبل انطلاق المباريات.

---

### 5. استراتيجية الخواص وإدارة الميزانية (Chips & Bank Strategy)

* **تجميد الخواص:** يمتلك الفريق ترسانة كاملة غير مستهلكة (2 Wildcard، 1 Free Hit، 1 Triple Captain، 1 Bench Boost). القاعدة الفنية الصارمة هنا هي **الامتناع التام عن تفعيل أي خاصية في هذه الجولة**؛ حيث تشير البيانات التاريخية إلى أن القيمة المضاعفة للخواص تبلغ ذروتها حصراً في جولات الحسم والمضاعفة (Double Gameweeks) وجولات الفراغ الكبرى (Blank Gameweeks) لتعظيم مكاسب النقاط.
* **قوة السيولة البنكية (£5.0m):** إبقاء هذا المبلغ الضخم في البنك ليس هدراً، بل هو قوة مالية كامنة تمنحنا مرونة مطلقة (Flexibility) في الجولات القادمة للقفز فوراً إلى أي عنصر سوبر-بريميوم يفرض نفسه في الساحة دون الحاجة لاقتطاع نقاط إضافية أو استخدام خاصية مبكرة.

---

### الخلاصة التنفيذية (Executive Summary)

ندخل الجولة 6 بتشكيل 3-5-2 هجومي متوازن وقائم على استثمار فوري مدروس لخصم النقاط (-4). القرارات ترتكز على طرد تراجع بالمر وتافرنيير، واقتناص إنتاجية غروس الاقتصادية وسكوت، مع إسناد القيادة إلى المحرك الإحصائي الأعلى برونو فيرنانديز (8.4 xP). الفريق الآن في أفضل وضعية تكتيكية للانطلاق بقوة في مسار التعويض مع حماية كاملة للخواص وتأمين سيولة نقدية ضخمة تصنع الفارق للجولات القادمة.

press_wire.title: FPL international break round-up
press_wire.summary: Aston Villa have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Following the completion of Gameweek 5, Fantasy Premier League managers can now start to identify trends in the data and develop a better understanding of the best players to own. With that in mind, here are Aston Villa’s three highest-scoring players in FPL so far… Emi Buendía (21 points) Buendía scored a stunner in last Saturday's win at Tottenham Hotspur, capping off a fine individual display from the £5.9m midfielder. In addition to his goal, the playmaker hit the defensive contribution (DefCon) threshold for the first time this season, thanks to two interceptions, six recoveries and seven tackles, and claimed the maximum bonus for a 12-point haul. Having also netted in Europe against Club Brugge, it’s no surprise that Buendía has started to show his true potential in FPL. In terms of the underlying numbers, Buendía ranks first among teammates for shots (nine), final-third touches (95) and passes received in the penalty area (seven). Capable of contributing both goals and assists, he’s third for chances created (five), too. John McGinn (17 points) McGinn (£5.4m), of course, provided the assist for that Buendía strike in North London. The Villa captain has now supplied assists in successive matches against Nottingham Forest and Spurs, a run which has seen him deliver 12 FPL points. The underlying data further highlights McGinn’s influence on Villa’s attack. Helped by a role on set plays, no teammate can better his total of six chances created and 19 attempted crosses this season. It’s not just about his assist potential, either. Frequently playing off the right, where he can cut inside onto his stronger left foot, he has already netted in Europe and recorded four shots in the Premier League. On top of that, McGinn provides something of a guarantee with regards to minutes, having started every Premier League game in 2026/27 so far, averaging 86.2 minutes per appearance. Zion Suzuki (16 points) Suzuki (£5.0m) had big gloves to fill upon his arrival at the club this summer, but the Japan international has made an impressive start to life as a Villan. Averaging 4.0 points per start, he’s already delivered a clean sheet against Hull City in Gameweek 3. He’s also racked up 15 saves across his first four matches, which have helped him earn three additional save points. Suzuki’s distribution has certainly added a new dimension to Villa’s play. Unai Emery’s men have seemed to adopt a more direct approach this season, with Suzuki’s ability with the ball at his feet key to this tactical evolution. Calm and composed, he’s completed 101 successful passes over the last four Gameweeks. Coventry City’s Carl Rushworth (£4.5m) delivered the first goalkeeper assist of 2026/27 on Saturday. Given Suzuki’s distribution, it might not be long before he joins that list.

press_wire.title: Internationals: Shea scores dramatic Northern Ireland winner
press_wire.summary: Shea Charles scored a sensational winner for Northern Ireland in the ninth minute of added time to secure a 1-0 victory over Georgia. The Nations League tie had been goalless, with Georgia’s Khvicha Kvaratskhelia seeing his second-half penalty saved by Shea’s brother, Pierce. That was until the Fulham midfielder stepped up to smash home the only goal of the game, sealing Northern Ireland’s first-ever Nations League B victory. Speaking post-match, Shea said: “I thought we fought really hard. To just come away with that winner is just incredible. “We're still a really young group and just to be able to keep our temper and defend like that towards the end of the game and come away with the winner - it's just really good.” Elsewhere, Calvin Bassey and Alex Iwobi both completed 90 minutes for Nigeria in their 2-1 win over Madagascar. The Super Eagles had fallen behind in the AFCON Qualifier before Iwobi threaded a beautiful ball through to George Ilenikhena, who equalised. In the second half, Moses Usor scored the winner to secure victory for Nigeria. They will next face Guinea-Bissau on Tuesday. Back in the Nations League, Timothy Castagne also played the full match as Belgium beat Italy 2-0 away from home, while Hugo Larsson was an unused substitute as Sweden beat Romania 2-1. In the Under-21 European Championship Qualifiers, Josh King starred as England ran out 4-2 winners over Kazakhstan, while Gonzalo García was handed the captain’s armband in Spain’s narrow 2-1 defeat to Finland.

press_wire.title: Jackson finds net for Senegal
press_wire.summary: Nicolas Jackson was on target as Senegal played out a 1-1 draw against Mozambique in Africa Cup of Nations qualifying on Friday. The Aston Villa striker found the net with a neat finish just after the half-hour mark, only for the hosts to level in first-half injury time and ensure the spoils were shared. Jackson completed 84 minutes for Senegal while compatriot and Villa team-mate Ibrahim Mbaye was introduced as a 63rd-minute substitute. The encounter was Senegal’s first of AFCON qualifying in Group J, with a trip to Ethiopia next up on Tuesday (ko 2pm). Victor Lindelöf helped Sweden get off to a winning start in the UEFA Nations League courtesy of a 2-1 triumph over Romania. The centre-back captained his country to all three points as he completed 90 minutes in Solna. It ensures Sweden sit top of League B Group 4 following their opening fixture of the competition, with a clash against Matty Cash’s Poland to come on Monday (ko 7.45pm). Elsewhere in League B Group 4, Cash completed 90 minutes as Poland played out a goalless draw against Bosnia and Herzegovina in Warsaw. The right-back helped keep a clean sheet for his nation to leave Poland on one point from their opening Nations League fixture.

press_wire.title: Wins For Everton Trio On International Duty
press_wire.summary: Vitalii Mykolenko, Tyrique George and Tyler Dibling all featured in international action on Friday evening. Mykolenko played every minute as Ukraine kicked off their UEFA Nations League campaign with an impressive 1-0 victory over Hungary in Budapest. A clean sheet for the full-back, he put in a sturdy defensive showing, making 16 defensive contributions including 12 clearances. Mykolenko and Ukraine’s next test sees them face Georgia on Monday 28 September. Young Lions George and Dibling helped England Under-21s claim a 4-2 win over Kazakhstan Under-21s at Molineux. Both Blues were named on the bench for the match – a UEFA European Championship qualifier – but George was substituted on when Chelsea winger Jamie Gittens headed off the field with an injury on 39 minutes. A positive performance from Everton’s George, he made two key passes and completed seven of his nine dribbles. Toffees teammate Dibling was introduced on 79 minutes, replacing Fulham's Josh King. Next up, England Under-21s face Slovakia Under-21s on Friday 2 October.

press_wire.title: Coventry City & Aston Villa away tickets
press_wire.summary: Tickets for Fulham's away trips to Coventry City and Aston Villa will go on sale from Thursday 1st October. Fulham take on The Sky Blues on Sunday 24th October, 3pm, and The Villans on Saturday 31st October, 8pm. Ticket Details Tickets for both these fixtures will go on sale to 2026/27 Season Ticket Holders at 9:30am on Thursday 1st October. 2026/27 Members will be able to purchase tickets from 9:30am on Monday 5th October. Any remaining tickets will then go on sale to Supporters with Previous Booking History* from 9:30am on Wednesday 7th October. Further matchday information, including a full list of on sale dates and ticket prices, can be found here: Coventry City and Aston Villa. Supporters can purchase up to two tickets per person online at fulhamfc.com/tickets, by calling the Ticket Office on 0203 871 0810 (Mon-Fri, 9:30am-5pm) or in person from the Ticket Office (Mon-Fri, 9:30am-4:30pm). BUY TICKETS FROM THURSDAY Important Information The 2026/27 season will see new Premier League requirements implemented for assigning tickets to supporters, with every seat sold being assigned to the individual who intends on attending the related match. Each attendee's name and contact details must be registered with the club. This means if a supporter purchases two tickets for a fixture, each ticket will need to be assigned to a unique client reference number. In the instance of a Season Ticket Holder purchasing additional tickets during their priority window, each ticket that they are purchasing will need to be assigned to each individual who intends on attending the related match. We therefore encourage all supporters planning on attending Premier League fixtures, home or away, to update their friends and family network ahead of the start of the season to ensure they can easily assign tickets at the point of purchase. Supporters can follow our step-by-step guide on how to do this here. *To qualify for Booking History status, supporters must have purchased a Fulham FC Men's First Team league match ticket in the past five years. Booking History status is not valid if supporters have only previously purchased tickets against the same opposition, in this case Coventry City and Aston Villa. You must have Booking History status prior to 2pm on Friday 25th September in order to be eligible to purchase tickets during this window.

press_wire.title: FOREST FIRSTS | 2026/27
press_wire.summary: Everyone remembers their first football match. Forest Firsts is our club initiative aimed at making young Nottingham Forest supporters making their first trip to the City Ground that extra bit special. With our success on the pitch growing season on season over the last six years, the demand for tickets at our world-famous venue has only risen. Our initiative gives Junior Reds members the opportunity to attend their first game with a small allocation being set aside for each game. The application form for each fixture is available when the ticket details are released for that particular game. Applications for our game against Arsenal in mid-October will be available soon. Please be advised that the parent attending must also be a MyForest member, and only two tickets can be applied for per application. Supporters should direct any queries to JuniorReds@nottinghamforest.co.uk.
